subject.title: fix(mattermost): truncate inbound preview on code-point boundary

question: Should the maintainer comment and production-path websocket regression be treated as a proof override for this external Mattermost verbose-log fix on the latest head?
rationale: ClawSweeper's external-PR gate normally requires real behavior proof or a formal override, but the patch is narrow and a maintainer already stated that the websocket monitor regression exercises the production logging path.

options.title: Accept proof override
options.body: Treat the maintainer-endorsed websocket monitor regression as sufficient for this verbose-log-only fix and continue normal exact-head landing once required checks are acceptable.

options.title: Require live verbose-log proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate active until the contributor adds redacted Mattermost verbose logs, terminal output, or another real runtime transcript showing the safe preview.

options.title: Pause until proof direction is settled
options.body: Do not merge this PR until maintainers explicitly choose whether test-path proof is enough for this logging-only edge case.

recommendation.title: Accept proof override
recommendation.body: Treat the maintainer-endorsed websocket monitor regression as sufficient for this verbose-log-only fix and continue normal exact-head landing once required checks are acceptable.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle already commented on proof sufficiency for the production logging path and has recent Mattermost monitor history.
